definitions.gloss: row of teeth; dentition; alignment of the teeth
definitions.explanation: The way the teeth are lined up in the mouth. A dental term, most often met in {歯列矯正|しれつきょうせい} (orthodontic treatment).

examples.japanese: {歯列|しれつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
{歯列|しれつ}⟦{矯正|きょうせい}→矯正：14784_kyousei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}めた。
{歯列|しれつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乱|みだ}れている→乱れる：09506_midareru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{磨|みが}き→磨く：02427_migaku⟧にくく⟦{虫歯|むしば}→虫歯：00299_mushiba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧やすい。
examples.english: When your teeth are out of line, they are hard to brush and decay easily.

notes:
A dental word; in everyday speech people say ⟦{歯並|はなら}び→歯並び：32305_hanarabi⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歯列|しれつ}⟦{矯正|きょうせい}→矯正：14784_kyousei⟧: orthodontic treatment, braces
- {歯列|しれつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乱|みだ}れる→乱れる：09506_midareru⟧: the teeth are out of line

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{歯並|はなら}び→歯並び：32305_hanarabi⟧: the line of one's teeth; the everyday word

WATCH OUT:
